name: Ai Suru Tsuma, Nagisa no Uwaki Kokuhaku Okuyukashii Tsuma no Karada ga, Aitsu no Geki Piston de Torokete Ita Shinjitsu
original_name: 愛する妻、渚の浮気告白 奥ゆかしい妻のカラダが、あいつの激ピストンでとろけていた真実
source:
One day, Hiroshi Munekata notices that his wife, Nagisa, has received a text message on her cell phone that hints at an affair.

Nagisa was so shy and reserved—there was no way she’d do something like that.
Thinking that, he asked her, “Have you ever been with anyone else?”

“Actually, just a little…”

Wait…

My wife—I was sure I was the only man she’d ever been with.

It was a devastating “confession of infidelity”—she had been melting with pleasure, drenched in sweat, in another man’s arms.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008566.html/]dlsite.com[/url]]
